description: Evaluates whether a candidate site or project location can support a target MW load, returning time-to-power estimates, composite site scores, nearby substations, water stress, and zoning risks. Pass a city, coordinates, or project name.

address.description: Street address, county, or site description.

include_opportunity_matrix.description: Include Time-to-Power vs Composite Site Score arbitrage matrix.

latitude.description: Site latitude in decimal degrees WGS84 (e.g. 39.9612).

load_mw.description: Proposed peak electrical load in megawatts (default: 100).

location.description: City, county, or regional market name (e.g. 'Columbus, OH', 'Ashburn, VA').

longitude.description: Site longitude in decimal degrees WGS84 (e.g. -82.9988).

project.description: Project name, alias, canonical project ID, Map project ID, queue ID, or developer plus place (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Hyperion', 'AXP-US-LA-00003', 'QTS Atlanta').

project_id.description: Optional project ID or canonical ID to evaluate at its coordinates (e.g. 'P017').

project_name.description: Optional project name to evaluate (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene').

query.description: Natural language screening query or project name (e.g. 'Screen 400 MW in Columbus, OH').

site.description: Project name, site name, city, county, or canonical ID (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Columbus, OH', 'Loudoun County, VA').

target_initial_energization_date.description: Target initial energization year or ISO date (e.g. 2028 or '2028-06-01').

target_mw.description: Alias for target electrical load in megawatts (e.g. 400).

name: assess_site_feasibility

next_useful_tools.description: Suggested follow-up MCP tools relevant to this result.

status.description: Execution status (OK, SUCCESS, RESOLVED, AMBIGUOUS_ENTITY, NOT_FOUND, ERROR).

using_project.description: Banner confirming the resolved project name, city, state, and canonical ID when a project was matched.

title: Assess Site Feasibility
